summary: Hybrid hire relocating internationally — temporary scoped VPN/bridge account and staggered device shipment pending background check
description:
Issue summary:
New hire Priya Nair (Software Engineer, Platform) is relocating to the UK and has an official start date of 2026-03-01. HR indicates the completion of the background check is delayed by 4–6 business days due to manual identity verification. HR requests a timebound, minimal-privilege access path so Priya can complete onboarding tasks (read-only docs, internal wiki, Slack, and a sandbox GCP project with no billing scope) before full clearance.

Impact:
- Priya cannot finish initial orientation checklists, internal training, or smaller repo walkthroughs prior to start date.
- Hiring manager requests limited access to accelerate ramp time.
- Logistics: preferred laptop shipment is delayed due to customs paperwork; HR asks for a company hotspot and a temporary bridge account in the UK office while hardware is en route.

Environment:
- Target region: eu-west (London) but control plane interactions occur from prod-us-west.
- Affected systems/components: SCIM/Okta provisioning, VPN (perimeter access), KMS/service account gating, device shipping vendor (ShipFast), JetBrains license allocation, GitHub org membership, Slack workspace.

Requested outcome / acceptance criteria:
1) Create a timebound bridge account or scoped group for Priya that grants: Slack, internal docs read, onboarding Confluence, and a sandbox GCP project read/write to non-billing resources. Bridge account must require MFA and expire automatically after 10 business days or when SCIM marks the user active.
2) Issue temporary SSH keys or a rotating machine user for code walkthroughs with repo-level read (no write) until full SCIM provisioning completes.
3) Approve shipment of a loaner hotspot and expedited customs paperwork to Priya's interim UK address; provide tracking and customs invoice to HR.
4) Reserve a JetBrains license and a seat in the UK office device pool as contingency if the laptop is delayed >7 business days.
5) Security must sign off on the access plan and document the timebound nature and audit events.

Notes on constraints:
- Security policy disallows permanent service-account credentials for bridge accounts; any service-account access must be ephemeral with short-lived tokens.
- KMS and production resource access must be explicitly excluded until SCIM shows full provisioning and ID verification.

Steps to reproduce / operational steps to fulfill request:
- HR provides interim address and start date (done).
- Security and SRE to approve bridge account group and expiration policy.
- Infrastructure team to create sandbox GCP project with billing disabled and add scoped IAM roles.
- Device logistics to schedule hotspot shipment and escalate customs paperwork with ShipFast.

Attachments provided by HR:
- Copy of Priya's signed offer (redacted), preferred interim shipping address, and passport scan used for customs paperwork (stored in HR vault).
requested_actions: Create bridge account 'bridge-priya-nair' with MFA and 10-business-day expiry
Provision read-only GitHub org membership and repo-level read for onboarding repos
Create sandbox GCP project (billing disabled) and grant staff-onboarding role
Coordinate hotspot shipment via ShipFast and attach customs invoice to ticket
Reserve a JetBrains development seat in UK office device pool
Security to review and approve ephemeral access plan and confirm audit logging

2026-02-26 14:45 Alex Rivera: Sandbox GCP project created (project-id: redwood-onboard-priya). Billing disabled; only non-billing APIs enabled. Added onboarding service account with short-lived access via workload identity federation. Need Security to confirm IAM roles are acceptable.

investigation_notes: Initial checks: SCIM entry for priya.nair@redwood does not exist (HR indicated provisioning is pending identity verification). Okta inbound log shows a failed synthesis step at 2026-02-24 18:22 related to address verification. Device-ops confirmed ShipFast slot availability. GCP quota is sufficient for one sandbox project; billing owner is a non-prod billing account that has been disabled per request. Proposed approach: create bridge account in Okta with minimal group memberships, create sandbox GCP project with workload identity for ephemeral access, and ship hotspot as loaner. Documented the plan to reconcile and deprovision upon SCIM active flag or after 10 business days.
resolution: TBD — in progress. Next actions: Alex/Rachel (device-ops) finalize shipping label and upload customs invoice by 2026-02-27 EOD; Security to confirm the exact IAM role bindings by 2026-02-27 noon; SCIM automation team to watch for identity verification completion and trigger deprovision calendar job. Post-completion, we will run access review and transfer any permanent entitlements via normal SCIM flow.
follow_up_tasks: Verify SCIM auto-deactivation triggers correctly after bridge expiry
Record the temporary access in the monthly onboarding audit (owner: Security)
If laptop delayed >7 business days, allocate office loaner and escalate JetBrains license assignment
